dash and dot lists split on tabs
tiny alpha prints as plain decimal like Rust f64 Display

label size absent is sm, present and empty stays empty (Some of empty string)
label size absent defaults to sm
label weight present and empty stays empty
label weight absent falls to the typography medium weight
label weight absent and no typography weight is 500
typography medium weight present and empty stays empty
dark variant colors layer over base colors the variant omits (card from base)
control: light key ignores the variant colors
control: no variant at all resolves the base on a dark key
